layout.reason: The layout is clean, well-aligned, and follows a logical three-column flow, though it is somewhat crowded with very little breathing room between sections.

readability.reason: There are several large walls of text with high density and small font size (especially in the Abstract, Motivation, Experimental Setup, and Discussion sections) that would be difficult to read from a normal viewing distance.

fidelity.reason: The poster perfectly captures all key aspects of the paper, including the test rig setup, the specific friction and angle measurements, the quadratic slippage results, and the limitations.

holistic.reason: The poster is highly faithful to the paper and has a logical layout, but it functions more like a paper on a board due to the excessive text density and large, crowded text blocks.
